full_llm_interaction_log.purpose: Setting up the IEEE LaTeX document structure correctly
full_llm_interaction_log.prompt: How do I configure a LaTeX file to use the IEEE conference format with exactly 10pt font and 1-inch margins? I need to enforce both constraints simultaneously.
full_llm_interaction_log.how_it_helped: Provided the exact preamble: \documentclass[conference,10pt]{IEEEtran} combined with \usepackage[margin=1in]{geometry}.
full_llm_interaction_log.student_verification: Compiled the document and verified 10pt body text and 1-inch margins in the PDF output.

full_llm_interaction_log.purpose: Embedding generated matplotlib figures into a two-column IEEE report
full_llm_interaction_log.prompt: I have a PNG saved to results/accuracy_evolution.png. What is the correct LaTeX to include it as a single-column figure with a caption at the correct width?
full_llm_interaction_log.how_it_helped: Provided the standard figure block: \begin{figure}[htbp] with \centerline{\includegraphics[width=\linewidth]{...}} and a \caption followed by \label.
full_llm_interaction_log.student_verification: Verified the figure appears at the correct width in the compiled PDF without overflowing the column.

full_llm_interaction_log.purpose: Formatting mathematical equations formally in the report
full_llm_interaction_log.prompt: I want to include the primal SVM objective and the RBF kernel formula as numbered equations in my IEEE report. What is the correct LaTeX math environment to use?
full_llm_interaction_log.how_it_helped: Showed the \begin{equation} ... \end{equation} block with amsmath package. Also explained how to use \frac, \sum, and \| \| for norms.
full_llm_interaction_log.student_verification: Both equations compiled correctly and the numbering is automatic.

full_llm_interaction_log.purpose: Debugging a table layout collision in LaTeX
full_llm_interaction_log.prompt: My Table 1 in LaTeX is visually colliding with the paragraph text above it. The table appears to be floating too close to the end of the preceding paragraph. How do I fix this?
full_llm_interaction_log.how_it_helped: Identified that the preceding paragraph had duplicate text which pushed the table up into the text flow. Suggested removing the duplicate and adding \vspace{0.2cm} below the table.
full_llm_interaction_log.student_verification: After the fix, the table renders cleanly with correct white space separation.

full_llm_interaction_log.purpose: Expanding the reflection section to reach 4 pages
full_llm_interaction_log.prompt: My report is 3.2 pages. I need to reach 4 pages without padding. What are substantive observations about the BSGD method I could add to the Reflection section?
full_llm_interaction_log.how_it_helped: Suggested discussing: the non-linear collapse of generalisation as budget drops, why projection is slower than merge despite similar accuracy (Woodbury vs. nearest-neighbour search), and Forgetron as an alternative approach.
full_llm_interaction_log.student_verification: Added these observations and confirmed the document reached 4 pages in the compiled PDF.
